limitations: Wednesday projections and roster positions are captured snapshot estimates, not final lineups.
Explicit empty starter slots and starter byes are preserved.
Transactions cover the 25 visible captured rows; this is not certified complete transaction history.
Raw capture page text and URLs are excluded.
Captured page text is capped at 220000 characters and contains styles before player tables; raw row captures supply the actual verification evidence.
GP is the captured selected-period GP column, not verified season games played.
Actual rank is verified as shown; the capture help defines it relative to the selected stats filter, so seasonRank is null.
Only 25 visible transactions (Nov11–18) are audited; do not claim complete transaction history.
